plan.goal: Generate one compact de novo protein candidate and collect sequence, structure, QC, and ranking evidence.
assumptions: A single short monomeric design of about 60 residues is an acceptable compact soluble-design target.
Solubility is approximated by lightweight sequence/QC heuristics such as GRAVY, instability index, polybasic burden, pI, and predicted confidence rather than experimental validation.
Ranking one candidate is still useful to consolidate evidence and produce a final scored record.
